Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

The `--c128-page-size` argument controls the NPU DSV4 C128 KV cache physical
page size. It must be a positive multiple of 16 (required by the Ascend sparse
attention operator), and its value must be wired through to the C128 KV pool's
`kernel_page_size`. These two invariants were previously only exercised
indirectly through e2e inference, with no focused unit coverage, so a regression
backed by a mis-wired or unvalidated page size could slip through CI.

## Modifications

- Add `TestC128PageSize` to `test_npu_ascend_dsv4_backend.py`:
  - `test_configured_page_size_reaches_npu_c128_kv_pool` asserts the configured
    value (16/32) is stored on the pool and forwarded as `kernel_page_size` when
    `_make_kv_pool` builds the C128 pool.
  - `test_invalid_page_size_is_rejected` asserts non-positive and non-16-multiple
    values (0, -16, 1, 24) raise `ValueError`.
- Mock `sgl_kernel_npu.kvcacheio` alongside the other optional NPU modules so the
  test file imports cleanly when that submodule is unavailable.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A — test-only change; no model forward or kernel code is modified.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A — no inference or performance code paths changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit` .
- [x] Add unit tests according to the `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests` .
- [ ] Update documentation according to `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations` .
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy`  and `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed` .
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance` .

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the `https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process` .
2. Get approvals from `https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS`  and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests`  or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,181 @@
+import os
+import unittest
+from threading import Lock
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.e2e.test_npu_performance_utils import (
+    DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_0731_W8A8_MODEL_PATH,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.simple_eval_common import ChatCompletionSampler
+from sglang.test.simple_eval_mixed_prefix_gsm8k import GSM8KEval, get_one_example
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(suite="full-8-npu-a3")
+
+# DeepSeek-V4-Flash W8A8 requires the same NPU runtime environment as the
+# existing accuracy/performance DSV4 cases.
+DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_ENVS = {
+    "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF": "expandable_segments:True",
+    "STREAMS_PER_DEVICE": "32",
+    "INF_NAN_MODE_FORCE_DISABLE": "1",
+    "SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY": "1",
+    "HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+    "GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME": "lo",
+    "HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE": "AIV",
+    "SGLANG_NPU_USE_MULTI_STREAM": "1",
+    "DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT": "1",
+    "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE": "2048",
+    "SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "35",
+    "DEEPEP_HYBRID_DEPLOYMENT": "1",
+    "SGLANG_ENABLE_WAR_BARRIER": "1",
+    "SGLANG_FORCE_COARSE_WAR_BARRIER": "1",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_FP8_WO_A_GEMM": "0",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_USE_OVERLAP_STORE_CACHE": "False",
+    "FORCE_DRAFT_MODEL_NON_QUANT": "1",
+    "SGLANG_DSV4_FP4_EXPERTS": "False",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_FUSE_WQA_WKV": "0",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_BF16_FP32_GEMM_ALGO": "torch",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_USE_FUSED_HASH_TOPK": "False",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_USE_TILELANG_MHC_PRE": "False",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_HC_PRENORM": "False",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_USE_TILELANG_MHC_POST": "False",
+}
+
+# A C128 physical page holds 16 compressed tokens, or 2048 original tokens.
+C128_PAGE_SIZE = 16
+PHYSICAL_PAGE_BOUNDARY_TOKENS = 128 * (C128_PAGE_SIZE + 1)
+TARGET_PREFIX_TOKENS = 3072
+PADDING_EXAMPLE = (
+    "Question: Mia has 4 apples and buys 3 more. How many apples does she have?\n"
+    "Answer: 4 + 3 = 7. #### 7\n\n"
+)
+
+DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_OTHER_ARGS = [
+    "--page-size",
+    "128",
+    "--tp-size",
+    "8",
+    "--trust-remote-code",
+    "--device",
+    "npu",
+    "--attention-backend",
+    "dsv4",
+    "--mem-fraction-static",
+    "0.70",
+    "--max-running-requests",
+    "16",
+    "--moe-a2a-backend",
+    "deepep",
+    "--deepep-mode",
+    "auto",
+    "--quantization",
+    "modelslim",
+    "--kv-cache-dtype",
+    "bfloat16",
+    "--c128-page-size",
+    str(C128_PAGE_SIZE),
+    "--context-length",
+    "8192",
+    "--disable-radix-cache",
+    "--skip-server-warmup",
+]
+
+
+class TestNpuC128PageSize(CustomTestCase):
+    """Testcase: Verify the NPU DSV4 C128 KV cache physical page size parameter
+    (--c128-page-size) supports inference across a C128 physical page boundary.
+
+    [Test Category] Parameter
+    [Test Target] --c128-page-size
+    """
+
+    model = DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_0731_W8A8_MODEL_PATH
+    base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        env = os.environ.copy()
+        env.update(DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_ENVS)
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=3600,
+            other_args=DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_W8A8_OTHER_ARGS,
+            env=env,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def test_c128_page_size_server_and_inference(self):
+        eval_obj = GSM8KEval(num_examples=100, num_threads=16, num_shots=20)
+        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model, trust_remote_code=True)
+        # Keep the shared prefix before sending requests so every question still crosses
+        # the 2176-token bound.
+        padding_examples = 0
+        prefix_tokens = len(
+            tokenizer.encode(eval_obj._few_shot_prompt, add_special_tokens=False)
+        )
+        while prefix_tokens < TARGET_PREFIX_TOKENS:
+            eval_obj._few_shot_prompt += PADDING_EXAMPLE
+            padding_examples += 1
+            next_prefix_tokens = len(
+                tokenizer.encode(eval_obj._few_shot_prompt, add_special_tokens=False)
+            )
+            prefix_tokens = next_prefix_tokens
+
+        min_encoded_prompt = min(
+            len(
+                tokenizer.encode(
+                    eval_obj._few_shot_prompt
+                    + get_one_example(eval_obj._lines, i, include_answer=False),
+                    add_special_tokens=False,
+                )
+            )
+            for i in range(100)
+        )
+        self.assertGreater(min_encoded_prompt, PHYSICAL_PAGE_BOUNDARY_TOKENS)
+
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"OPENAI_API_KEY": "EMPTY"}):
+            sampler = ChatCompletionSampler(
+                base_url=f"{self.base_url}/v1",
+                model=self.model,
+                max_tokens=4096,
+                temperature=0.0,
+                extra_body={
+                    "chat_template_kwargs": {"thinking": True, "reasoning_effort": "high"}
+                },
+            )
+
+        # Record the server's token count for each request. A C128 physical page
+        # holds 16 compressed tokens, each formed from 128 original tokens; the
+        # 17th compressed token (at 2176 tokens) must use a second page.
+        prompt_tokens = []
+        lock = Lock()
+        create = sampler.client.chat.completions.create
+
+        def record_prompt_tokens(*args, **kwargs):
+            result = create(*args, **kwargs)
+            if result.usage is not None and result.usage.prompt_tokens is not None:
+                with lock:
+                    prompt_tokens.append(result.usage.prompt_tokens)
+            return result
+
+        sampler.client.chat.completions.create = record_prompt_tokens
+        result = eval_obj(sampler)
+        self.assertEqual(len(prompt_tokens), 100)
+        self.assertGreater(min(prompt_tokens), PHYSICAL_PAGE_BOUNDARY_TOKENS)
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(result.score, 0.93)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

     "torch_npu",
     "torch_npu.contrib",
     "sgl_kernel_npu",
+    "sgl_kernel_npu.kvcacheio",
     "sgl_kernel_npu.attention",
     "sgl_kernel_npu.attention.sinks_attention",
     "sgl_kernel_npu.norm",
@@ -75,6 +76,52 @@ def _per_step_draft_out_cache_loc(out_cache_loc, batch_size, topk, num_steps):
 from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_req_to_token_pool import (
     DSV4ReqToTokenTablesMixin,
 )
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool
+
+
+class TestC128PageSize(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_configured_page_size_reaches_npu_c128_kv_pool(self):
+        for page_size in (16, 32):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(page_size=page_size),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool.get_schedule",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(c128_page_size=page_size),
+                ),
+                patch.object(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool, "__init__", return_value=None),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool.NPUDeepSeekV4SingleKVPool"
+                ) as kv_pool_cls,
+            ):
+                pool = DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool()
+                pool.qk_nope_head_dim = 128
+                pool.qk_rope_head_dim = 64
+                pool._make_kv_pool(
+                    size=256,
+                    page_size=1,
+                    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                    layer_num=1,
+                    device="cpu",
+                    enable_memory_saver=False,
+                    global_page_size=128,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(pool.c128_page_size, page_size)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    kv_pool_cls.call_args.kwargs["kernel_page_size"], page_size
+                )
+
+    def test_invalid_page_size_is_rejected(self):
+        for page_size in (0, -16, 1, 24):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(page_size=page_size),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool.get_schedule",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(c128_page_size=page_size),
+                ),
+                patch.object(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool, "__init__", return_value=None),
+            ):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "positive multiple of 16"):
+                    DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool()
 
 
 class TestVerifyCompressPositions(unittest.TestCase):
